summary: Ran the report on every commit between v2.3.0 and v2.4.0 against the March rows of the ledger. History is linear and 9a04783 is the first bad commit, preceded by good 4ad51a1. Its change to tally/dates.py makes parse_stamp convert to UTC, which shifts the booking date. The earliest tag containing it is v2.4.0rc1.
